title: Review Rerun regression fix: no camera depth point cloud
objective: Verify the latest Builder fix removes the unwanted Rerun depth point cloud while keeping camera/frustum, projected RGB, and 2D image streams available.
instructions: Confirm no rr.DepthImage is logged under spear/camera or any camera child path.
Confirm camera/frustum remains at spear/camera and projected RGB remains under camera only as spear/camera/rgb_projection.
Confirm regular 2D streams are under spear/images/rgb, spear/images/depth_meters, spear/images/world_normal_visualization, and spear/images/diffuse_color_visualization.
Confirm docs reflect those paths without claiming depth is projected in 3D.

artifacts: For the flashlight programmatic Rerun stream, keep rr.DepthImage outside spear/camera because Rerun back-projects camera-child depth images into 3D point clouds.

expected_outputs: ResultPacket with approve/block status and concise findings.
definition_of_done: Review result explicitly says whether the unwanted point cloud regression is removed.
